research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: retained frozen three employment spells, added named businesses, four governance bodies and sporting/mentoring distinction. Primary first speech resolves Cavanagh year discrepancy in favour of1981; no frozen roster refresh.

ANZ full-time commencement is explicit in conference biography and corroborating profile, not inferred from bank-officer title. Official1969–1976 years imply conditional gross6–8calendar years if full-time continued; precise months, continuity and breaks absent. No exact7-year claim and no numeric headline. Private banking control supported by historical shareholder/merger evidence.

Gym chronology is materially unresolved: ABC1979 Funlife, party1981 unnamed centre, ABC1982 Fairview, reported ASICApril1983 registration, manager end2007,2012ownership account and2018spokesman denial of recent interest. Dates may represent different business/ownership/work events; do not flatten them. Three centres reported but only two named. Aggregate and component spells overlap, not additive.

Government-funded client services do not make fitness business public employment. Library board fee entitlement is supported but cannot be promoted to full-time public work; no individual fee extrapolated from aggregate report bands.

Avenues checked: party/parliamentary chronology, first speech, historical library annual report, ANZ history/report, ABC election profiles,2016conference biography,2012profile and2018AAP account. Funlife employer site inaccessible; CRANAplus subsequent reader request403 after initial/indexed access. No bypass attempted. No attributable public professional CV found; American cybersecurity/union officers and Cronulla administrator namesakes excluded.

Follow-up: ANZ dates/status/leave and legal-entity transfer; gym1981vs1979 start, third site, entity/operator dates/hours and ownership exit; library appointment start, planning/LGA/MRC dates and pay; athlete/mentor pay. Last review2026-10-01. South Australian initial pass ends with this record; proceed to Tasmania before unresolved follow-up pass.

Follow-up2026-10-02: Libraries Board appointment start resolved to15April2004 with gazette plus contemporary annual report.2005gazette supplies separate term beginning9June2005; possible gap/holdover15April–8June2005 retained as unknown. Existing actual26October2007retirement preserved despite scheduled2008expiry. Governance remains excluded.

Targeted third fitness-centre, business start and planning-commission searches repeated knownABCsequence or unrelated namesakes; no new hours or ownership-transfer proof. Contemporary planning minutes name a Studio Nine architect Tony Zappia and are not this member’s career. Next seek bank continuity/leave, third gym entity and individual operating periods, planning/LGA/MRCappointment instruments.

Follow-up2026-10-04: official ABR history resolves that Antonio was expressly named in the Funlife family partnership from1November1999 to17May2001. Later entity-name versions use initials and include two A Zappia partners, so they cannot prove Tony's continuing ownership; no ABN or business-name date was treated as an employment boundary. Funlife's employer site corroborates a1979 family founding and names Dominic Trimboli as current owner/operator but supplies no transfer date. ANZ continuity/leave, pre-1999 gym legal forms, third-centre identity, personal hours and exact ownership/operating exit remain unresolved; no headline years calculated.
